step.name: Body search
step.what_happens: An officer of the same gender pats the visitor down lightly and passes a hand-held metal detector over the body.
slow_when: The visitor wears a jacket or many accessories.
The wand alarms on a belt or jewelry.
rules: Female visitors are searched only by female officers.
Officers never ask a visitor to remove a hijab.
A visitor can ask for a search behind a screen.

exceptions.what: The wand alarms and the officer checks again.
The visitor asks for a search behind a screen.
